name: hello-box
title: Hello box
summary: The smallest complete document: a four-field header, one box filling it, and centred text.
prompt: Make the simplest possible RemoteCompose document: a 300×200 teal card with "Hello" centred in it.
teaches: Declare a document with the four header fields it needs: apiLevel 7, width and height in dp, profiles 513
Fill the document with a box and centre its child with horizontalAlignment / verticalAlignment center
Show text with a fontSize and a colour (6-digit #RRGGBB colours are opaque)

snippets.note: apiLevel 7, size in dp, profiles 513 (needed for text)
a box with fillMaxSize, a background and a centred child

check.describe: A teal card with white centred text. Resized (200×200, 450×160) the box still fills the document and Hello stays centred.

pitfalls: Without "profiles": 513 in the header json2rc refuses text components (the Java parser falls back to an older text op); keep it in every document that shows text
A text without fontSize is 36 and without color is black: set both, especially on a dark background
A box with children aligns them start/top by default; centring needs both horizontalAlignment and verticalAlignment
